description: This file contains a JUnit test class for testing the Square operation in a calculator application. It verifies the perform method and the getName method of the Square class.

classes.name: SquareTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the Square operation, extending AbstractOperationTest.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test by creating an instance of Square.

methods.name: testPerform
methods.description: Tests that the perform method of the Square operation correctly computes the square of 2.0.

methods.name: testGetName
methods.description: Verifies that the getName method of the Square operation returns 'x²'.
